name: @portiq/mcp
description: Portiq MCP server (stdio) — let AI agents browse and run your Portiq API library.

scripts.build: node scripts/gen-version.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node -e "require('fs').writeFileSync('dist/package.json', JSON.stringify({ type: 'commonjs' }))"
scripts.bundle: npm run build && esbuild dist/bin.js --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --target=node20 --external:better-sqlite3 --outfile=dist/portiq-mcp.bundle.cjs && node -e "require('fs').chmodSync('dist/portiq-mcp.bundle.cjs', 0o755)"
